meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动化实验室数据管理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Benchling平台上自动化处理实验数据与库存。
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data management on Benchling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate lab data and inventory operations on Benchling.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 Python SDK 或 REST API 操作 Benchling 平台，包括管理 DNA/RNA/蛋白质等注册实体、库存样本、电子实验记录、工作流任务，以及查询数据仓库和设置事件集成。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 自动化处理 Benchling 上的实验数据，例如创建序列、转移样本、更新实验记录或触发工作流时，它会调用此技能。

say.text: 将容器 cont_abc123 转移到位置 box_xyz789。
say.note: Claude 会执行库存转移操作。

say.text: 查询数据仓库中最近一周的实验结果。
say.note: Claude 会执行 SQL 查询并返回数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can interact with the Benchling platform via Python SDK or REST API, including managing registry entities (DNA, RNA, proteins), inventory samples, electronic lab notebook entries, workflow tasks, querying the Data Warehouse, and setting up event integrations.
howto.when_en: This skill is triggered when you ask Claude to automate Benchling lab data tasks, such as creating sequences, transferring samples, updating entries, or triggering workflows.

say_en.text: Create a DNA sequence named 'My Plasmid' with bases ATCGATCG using the Benchling SDK.
say_en.note: Claude will call the SDK to create the sequence and return the result.

say_en.text: Transfer container cont_abc123 to location box_xyz789.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the inventory transfer operation.

say_en.text: Query the Data Warehouse for experimental results from the last week.
say_en.note: Claude will run a SQL query and return the data.
